messages.content: What is RACF?

RACF (Resource Access Control Facility) is IBM's security product for z/OS mainframes. It provides:

1. User Authentication - Validates user IDs and passwords
2. Access Control - Controls who can access datasets, programs, and resources
3. Auditing - Logs security events for compliance
4. User/Group Management - Organizes users into groups with shared permissions

RACF protects resources through profiles that define access rules.
Write RACF command to add a new user

ADDUSER NEWUSER NAME('JOHN DOE') -
  OWNER(ADMIN) -
  DFLTGRP(USERGRP) -
  PASSWORD(TEMPPASS) -
  OPERATIONS -
  TSO(ACCTNUM(ACCT001) -
      PROC(PROC01) -
      SIZE(4096) -
      MAXSIZE(0))
Write RACF command to alter a user

ALTUSER USERID -
  NAME('JANE DOE') -
  PASSWORD(NEWPASS) -
  NOEXPIRED -
  RESUME
Write RACF command to delete a user
DELUSER OLDUSER
Write RACF command to list user information
LISTUSER USERID ALL
Write RACF command to add a group

ADDGROUP NEWGROUP -
  OWNER(ADMIN) -
  SUPGROUP(SYS1) -
  DATA('NEW USER GROUP')
Write RACF command to connect user to group

CONNECT USERID GROUP(GROUPNAME) -
  OWNER(ADMIN) -
  AUTH(USE)
Write RACF command to permit dataset access

PERMIT 'HLQ.DATASET.**' ID(USERID) ACCESS(READ)

PERMIT 'HLQ.DATASET.**' ID(USERID) ACCESS(UPDATE)

PERMIT 'HLQ.DATASET.**' ID(USERID) ACCESS(ALTER)
Write RACF command to define a dataset profile

ADDSD 'HLQ.DATASET.**' -
  OWNER(ADMIN) -
  UACC(NONE) -
  AUDIT(ALL(READ))
Write RACF command to define a general resource

RDEFINE FACILITY PROGRAM.NAME -
  OWNER(ADMIN) -
  UACC(NONE) -
  AUDIT(ALL(READ))

SETROPTS RACLIST(FACILITY) REFRESH
Write RACF command to list dataset profile
LISTDSD DATASET('HLQ.DATASET.**') ALL
Write RACF command to search for profiles

SEARCH CLASS(DATASET) MASK('HLQ.**')

SEARCH CLASS(USER) MASK(USR*)

SEARCH CLASS(GROUP) MASK(GRP*)
